scripts.clean: npx rimraf node_modules .nyc_output tmp private_key.pem certificates
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:cjs && npm run test:esm
scripts.//check:package: verifies the published shape of node-opcua-pki: exports map, files globs, and the per-condition types each consumer resolves. attw is what catches an ESM consumer being handed CommonJS types (FalseCJS) - present in 6.18.0 - which a runtime import() smoke test does not. Run after build: it packs the real dist.
scripts.__comment: lerna version bumps version, generates CHANGELOG.md, commits, tags, and pushes. Publish is done by GitHub Actions.
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run test && npx lerna version
scripts.release:minor: npm run build && npm run test && npx lerna version minor
scripts.release:major: npm run build && npm run test && npx lerna version major
